notes.title: Woodfel 1.041 Hotfix - Fixing macOS issues.
notes.content: This is just a small hotfix to fix a couple of issues with the macOS version.

notes.title: Woodfel 1.04 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This patch for Woodfel brings mostly performance improvements, but also a few bug fixes.

Performance Improvements
Woodfel has been updated to use the latest version of the Unity engine, bringing better support for newer hardware, including Apple Silicon and Metal for the macOS version.
The grass FX have been re-implemented to be much more efficient and compatible. The old grass used geometry shaders which were a bit too heavy for older GPUs.

Fixes
A few network bugs which prevented players from connecting to each others games properly have been fixed.
Scrolls can now be used from world inventories.

Some more actual content will be coming soon, rather than just these quality-of-life fixes!

notes.title: Woodfel 1.03 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Another small but important update for Woodfel today! I've added a shortcut key for quick inventory transfer, and improved some networking of inventory item moves.

You can now ctrl-click to instant transfer items from your personal inventory to a world inventory and vice-versa. There is a new key define so if ctrl doesn't work for you, you can change it to something else.

This was a long-requested feature which makes inventory management a bit nicer.

Enjoy! :D

notes.title: Woodfel 1.02 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is another small update for Woodfel. I've added a UI scaling slider to the in-game settings, which allows you to make the UI smaller (quite nice for larger screens). I have also fixed the position of the admin button (visible to server admins by using the /admin command in the chat window), which was accidentally hidden behind the expanded hud menu buttons.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Woodfel 1.01 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is just a small patch to add a Discord link into the game main menu, tether the Quest NPC's so they don't wander off too far, and switch the macOS build to use the Metal renderer by default (this disables grass on Metal as the shader is unsupported, but increases the framerate considerably).

I hope people have been enjoying the game so far!
Thanks!

notes.title: Woodfel 1.0 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The Woodfel 1.0 update is now live! This update will bring an end to our time in Steam Early Access and takes the game into full release.

This huge update brings an all-new quest system to the game, allowing you to experience the story of Woodfel as you help different NPC's and factions, and earn quest rewards for your efforts!

There is now also a completely revamped tutorial and help system, which should give players a better introduction to the features of the game, such as combat, crafting, and the different ways to build things!

I hope you all enjoy the update!

Full changelog:

Major New Features:
- NPC’s, Quest System & Storyline - Several NPC’s (Non-player characters) can now be found in Woodfel. These NPC’s will offer quests (if they have an exclamation mark over their head) which will take you through the tutorial and on to the main questline. The main story quest will introduce you to the major factions and have you investigate some strange goings on in the land of Woodfel!

- New tutorial & Help System - There is now a slightly more hand-holding tutorial to help players get acquainted with the game and controls. A more informative help section has also been added to the escape menu.

- Creature Gang Events - Several new events added which can be completed by defeating the specified group of creatures in the target area. A reward chest will appear after the last creature has been defeated.

Additions:
- Large Wooden Chest recipe can now be bought from either faction merchant, allowing you to store more items in one place!

- Added a new ability to players - Kick combat action. This attack deals a high amount of damage with a longer cooldown. Players learn this ability by default and it will appear on a new player's action bar.

- More conversation system improvements to add some flavoring dialogue to NPC’s.

- Added a quest book button to the HUD so you can track your current and completed quests.

- Quest icons are shown on the map when quests are available to be collected or progressed.

- Added quest tracking to the HUD above the world events, where your current tracked quest objective and progress is indicated.

- In newly created worlds the starting area is now a small town with some useful objects (storage chest, crafting table, furnace and some farm plots).

- Added an arrow based HUD objective indicator which more clearly shows the direction of your target, and is less confuseable with selection.

- Added world tier indication to the HUD world name tooltip. This indicates the maximum tier of events which can spawn in the world.

- Coal and Iron deposits will now occasionally spawn on the surface.

- Added several eyepatch vanity items so you can be more like a pirate.

- Added a day/night ambient soundscape, with a separate volume slider.

- Added an achievement for completing chapter one of the main story quest.

Improvements & QoL Changes:
- Daub Mixture & Worked Stone recipes now correctly describe their source as from merchants.

- World events now have a cooldown time after completing them which should help cycle through more event variety.

- Boss minions now have a cooldown time to prevent instant respawning.

- Added a particle effect for when build-objects are placed or removed.

- Added some more early-game equipment items to help players gear up and give more stat variety.

- Creatures with dialogue will now have a right-mouse-button indicator when you hover over them, and will wait for a short while when you begin conversing with them.

- Quest & World Event sections on the HUD are now collapsible and have improved scrolling behaviour.

- The world centre will now always spawn for Maeve and Hamish to wander about on.

- Escaping Hedgehogs are now 25% slower.

- Cleaned up some faction naming discrepancies.

- Merchant events now use a smaller event plate, and do not expire.

- Wild Plant Seeds now have a higher chance to drop from fern plants.

- Creatures should wall-jump less frequently, and really only if they can scale the obstacle.

- There is now a small animation indicating if an item has been placed into your backpack.

- Tool durability now counts whichever hand the item is equipped in (Though not in vanity slots). Tool hardness has been added to the item tooltip.

- Dead creatures now despawn slightly faster.

- Added sound effects and improved animation to airships - these behaviors now also work for all players on a server.

- Added a small noise when gathering.

- Pressing Escape will now re-show the HUD if it has been hidden.

- Teleport abilities (Home & Stuck) now describe their cooldown on their tooltips.

- World events now show which tier they are to convey their difficulty.


Bug Fixes:
- Footsteps of other players can now be heard in multiplayer games.

- Fixed a bug where map tooltips would remain on screen once the map had been closed.

- Creatures will now return to their spawn point if they fall off the world.

- Fixed skinning error on Kimono player torso (armpits had incorrect weighting).

- Fixed a bug where remote clients would appear to have interrupted an action, but it still completed on the server.

- Pressing exit on the main menu will now exit the game.

- Fix for some events not showing on the hud for some connected players.

- Fixed not being able to scroll the list of items in a merchant shop properly.

- Fixed wood fence build-item blocking being incorrect.

- Fixed durability damage failing to apply to items if drop-items-on-death was enabled.

notes.title: Woodfel 1.0 Launching on July 28th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm pleased to announce that Woodfel version 1.0 is launching on July 28th!

This is a massive update to Woodfel with the following major new features:


 An all-new quest system with NPC's, and a main story quest to play through.
 A completely revamped tutorial to introduce players to the game in a more engaging way.
 New multi-creature world events with rewards.
 Lots of new items, including vanity, and a new combat ability.


There have also been many smaller improvements, bug fixes and quality-of-life changes which will be detailed in full in the coming days!

I hope you enjoy the update when it arrives!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.847 - Achievements
notes.content:
Hey Woodfolks!

This months update brings a couple of new small features, some tweaks & bug fixes, and the addition of Steam Achievements to Woodfel!

There are 18 achievements to earn, including two hidden ones for you to discover! The achievements are for crafting, building, gearing up and for defeating certain boss creatures, so get out there and earn them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639310/027aef51788604d066938c7de06a2c8232b30e31.png

The other changes are:

- Added a new chat tab for miscellaneous messages - which should make player chat more obvious. Chat tabs have a small indicator to alert the player to unread messages.
- Added a world online status indicator to the world name panel. This will indicate if you are playing offline, hosting a server, or connected to a server.
- Fixed a bug where your current crafting recipe would deselect when learning or discovering a new recipe.
- Dropped items will now begin blinking when they are due to despawn, and should not fall through the world anymore. Items which do manage to fall out the world will respawn above.
- Early crafting station items have been reduced to Superior item rarity, reflecting their easier to craft status.
- Multiple players can now get reputation (and achievement) credit for killing creatures together.


This update may be the last with Woodfel in Early Access too! I've got a few more small things to work on but I soon plan to take Woodfel out of early access and up to version 1.0.

Hope you enjoy the update :D

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.846 - Vanity Layer Update
notes.content:
Hey Woodfolks!

This update brings another long-requested feature to Woodfel; A vanity equipment layer!

Now on your character panel (default C key) you will see a new tab called Vanity. On this tab you can equip any head, outfit, hand or accessory items to visually override your equipment! 

Note that items equipped on the vanity tab will have their stats disabled if they have any. Your main equipped items will keep using their stats though, just make sure they are used on the equipment tab.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639310/3cb636d10bdfc870a8745f8be5896182a6fd2ad6.png

This should let players look just the way they want to, without having to sacrifice style for stats!

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.845 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Woodfolks!

This is another small quality-of-life build for Woodfel mostly addressing world save management.

- Added a small bin button to each world listed in the load game panel. This allows you to delete worlds which are broken or you no longer need. There is a confirm dialog, but it is a permanent delete so use carefully.

- Incomplete worlds will now be listed. These are usually worlds which have been generated but did not get saved. If you want to use their world name you must delete them first.

- Fixed a small visual UI glitch when opting to replay the tutorial.

- Secondary axis for camera & character movement are now unbound by default to avoid unexpected controller input.

- Added tooltips for empty character equipment slots to say which type of gear they are for.

- Added tooltips for farm & smelter slots to say what each slot is for.

- Dark Hedgehogs will no longer flee when their health is low.

Hope this update helps with some issues players have experienced!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.844 - Map Feature Update
notes.content:
Hey Woodfolks!

This update finally brings a long awaited feature to Woodfel, an in-game map!

When you jump back into the game you'll see a slightly re-arranged HUD menu to make room for the new map button. Open the map (you can also use a shortcut, default the M key) and you'll see the world map.

The map can either follow your location, or remain static and allow you to pan around. On the map you'll see player locations & directions, your home point, and the locations of any active world events!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35639310/e5a6a1ab8dfdf2d6fba5f290840e00ecb15029a6.png

You can also toggle the map between a large and small size, which is handy when you want to keep the map view open while running about.

The map is a great way to find your way around, find your friends, and get a birds eye view of your creations!

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.843a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This patch adds keybinding to Woodfel. This should allow people to configure the game controls to suit them a little more.

To rebind controls, start or load a game and in the settings panel you will see a button to edit keybinds. Then simply click one of the control keybinds to change it to a different key or button.

This does add some basic controller support to the game (best when using alt camera mode), though really only for moving around, using items/abilities on the action bar, or interacting with the world.

Menu, UI & inventory controls are still all mouse based.

I also fixed a small bug with the 'Message of the Day' feature, where it would append an empty line to the MOTD each time to world was loaded.

I hope this is a useful update for some people!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.842a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi folks,
First build of 2022!
This patch is mostly about tweaking some crafting balance to make the game a bit nicer - especially early on.

- Wooden chest recipe is now known by all players by default, and the recipe scroll has been removed from drop tables. Some people found their inventories filling up too fast early on before they managed to get the drop or learn the recipe through discovery.
- Added Wooden Block voxel tile recipe (known by default) to give players a different block item to build with.
- Dark Tile Roof recipe has been added to more drop tables.
- Some inventory items have had their background colour fixed.
- Removed placeholder text from the starting world screen.
- Coarse Thread and Linen Fabric have had their required ingredients reduced.
- Linen & Cotton Fabric crafting now contributes towards discovering more clothing recipes.
- Crafting Daub Mixture and Worked Stone now contribute to their respective full-set discovery.
- Daub Mixture recipe now crafts 5 items instead of 1 (required ingredients have been increased too)
- Daub Mixture & Worked Stone recipes have been added to merchants too (They were a little hard to get as drops-only).
- Merchants will now exchange your unwanted Copper Ore for Iron Ore.
- Added a server 'Message of the day' feature. Use chat command /setmotd followed by the message you want to greet players on your server.

I hope these changes make the game a little more enjoyable!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.841a Winter Build Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey folks!
Today the festive season has arrived in Woodfel! The Winter event is now live with some items to discover..

- Festive Ironwood trees will now grow across your world, they can yield a special kind of Ironwood and seeds. 
- Creatures and bosses have a chance of dropping some festive loot - and your toughest foes will have something new too! Can you find the new items?
- Under the hood seasonal events have now been automated and will enable and disable based on the Steam server date. The Winter event will run until the 9th of January.

Hope you all enjoy the update!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.840a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
This is just a small update for Woodfel as I get back into improving the game.

- Updated Coal tile texture to be more distinct (they now softly smoulder to stand out underground)
- Airships will now drift back down beneath the build-height if they are not being piloted. This should prevent them from being lost if you accidentally fall off.
- Slightly increased the audio range of some quieter sound effects.
- Added Wild Nuts to allow planting and growing of trees.
- Added Plant Pots to allow growing of miniaturized plants & trees. Recipes for these will be learned by default.
- Planters, Pots and Gardens will remember what was grown in them when the world is saved & reloaded.
- Removed Summer items from drop tables - these will return next year!

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.839a Summer Build Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is another small update for Woodfel today, which adds the first seasonal vanity items and a couple of other things!
- Added a bed object for players to build - right click a bed to set your home point!
- Removed the home point chat command now that the bed is in-game.
- Players will now respawn at their homepoint (rather than their log-in position).
- Some more interactable objects will highlight when the mouse is over them.
- Fixed portal travel resulting in remote clients falling through the world.
- Added stone blocks to the players default recipes (was previously missing & unlearnable).
- Added a small welcome message to chat, along with a /help command which lists some useful commands.
- Some system chat messages now omit the sender name, and are coloured distinctly.
- Added Summer Sunglasses seasonal vanity items which drop from lower level mobs (There are three colours to collect!).

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.838a Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is a small build to add a single much needed improvement; Split stack!

You can now shift-click a stacked inventory item to split the stack in half. The separated stack will appear in the same inventory if there's space, or your other personal inventories or active storage chest. The stack will drop to the world if there's no inventory space.

Hopefully this makes creating charcoal much nicer! And you can now share resources easier with your friends too.

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.837a Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is the second quality-of-life build, to help improve the game experience.
- Fixed creatures despawning while in combat.
- Fixed distant bosses falling constantly for remote clients.
- Resources now deselect immediately when they expire.
- Iron blocks now have a more distinct graphic.
- Added a mouse-hover interaction prompt for resources and other usable objects.
- Added alt-mouse mode to enable constant mouselook. Press the left alt key to toggle in and out of this mode - the escape menu will also leave the mode. When in alt mouse mode you can interact with things by aiming at them and using the right mouse button (The interaction prompt will show when within range).

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.836a Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is the first small quality-of-life build to address some issues players have found:
- Fixed a small smoothing issue on wood wall windows.
- Improved physics on stairs particularly when framerate is low.
- Creatures now use an orange selection reticle to differentiate from players.
- Small increase to resource drops of ironwood, plant fibres and wild seeds.
- Tall tree leaves now fade out when they block the camera.
- Airship canopies now fade out when they block the camera.
- Crafting alerts now show in the hud instead of in chat.
- 'Stuck' ability added to abilities panel to free the player if they become trapped.
- 'Home' ability added to allow the player to teleport home. Home will be set when a character next logs in.
- /home chat command to display your home position coordinates.
- /sethome chat command to update your home position (This will be removed when beds are added later).
- /where chat command to display your current coordinates.

notes.title: Woodfel Version 0.835a Patch Notes
notes.content:
This is a small bug fix patch for mostly multiplayer issues:
- Fixed airships not spawning for non-server players.
- Fixed some treasure chests getting stuck for non-server players.
- Fixed an issue where some creatures would appear to be un-attackable.
- Fixed knockback not being apparent to non-server players.
- Fixed some UI windows not closing when the escape key was pressed (farms, chests, anvils and smelters).
